I’m helping a family get settled in Raleigh, North Carolina, and I want to line up both healthcare and childcare in one pass so they have real options to review on screen. Here is the structured healthcare and childcare report for a family settling in Raleigh, North Carolina. All official insurer plan pages, provider directories, pediatrician profiles, and daycare center websites have been opened in their own browser tabs and left open for your direct inspection.

---

### Section 1: Major Health Insurance Plans in Raleigh, NC

1. **Blue Cross and Blue Shield of North Carolina (Blue Cross NC)**
   * **Plan Overview:** **Blue Advantage / Individual & Family Health Plans** (comprehensive statewide PPO offering access to over 95% of North Carolina doctors and specialists without referrals, as well as tiered options like Blue Select and focused network options like Blue Value).
   * **Plan Consumer Overview Page:** [Tab 787784006] — `https://www.bcbsnc.com/shop-plans/health`
   * **Provider Directory / Doctor Search Page:** [Tab 787784007] — `https://www.bcbsnc.com/members/find-care`

2. **UnitedHealthcare (UHC)**
   * **Plan Overview:** **UnitedHealthcare Individual & Family Plans / Choice Plus Network** (individual ACA Marketplace and employer-sponsored health plans providing broad in-network coverage across major North Carolina health systems, preventive pediatric care, and national network portability).
   * **Plan Consumer Overview Page:** [Tab 787784008] — `https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families`
   * **Provider Directory / Doctor Search Page:** [Tab 787784009] — `https://www.uhc.com/find-a-doctor`

3. **Aetna**
   * **Plan Overview:** **Aetna Individual & Family Plans / Open Choice PPO** (individual exchange and commercial employer coverage featuring access to local health systems, virtual primary care, and integrated pharmacy/walk-in clinic benefits through CVS MinuteClinic).
   * **Plan Consumer Overview Page:** [Tab 787784010] — `https://www.aetna.com/individuals-families.html`
   * **Provider Directory / Doctor Search Page:** [Tab 787784011] — `https://www.aetna.com/individuals-families/find-a-doctor.html`

---

### Section 2: Pediatricians in Raleigh Accepting These Plans

All 11 pediatricians below practice directly within Raleigh city limits and accept Blue Cross NC, UnitedHealthcare, and Aetna:

1. **Dr. Theresa Flynn, MD, MPH** (Pediatrician)
   * **Clinic:** WakeMed Pediatric Primary Care – Raleigh Campus
   * **Location:** Andrews Center, 3024 New Bern Avenue, Suite 201, Raleigh, NC 27610
   * **Accepted Insurances:** Blue Cross NC, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare
   * **Profile Page Tab:** [Tab 787784012] — `https://www.wakemed.org/provider/theresa-flynn-md-mph-pediatric-primary-care`

2. **Dr. Lori Stiegemeier, DO** (Pediatrician)
   * **Clinic:** Duke Children's Primary Care Brier Creek
   * **Location:** 10211 Alm Street, Suite 200, Raleigh, NC 27617
   * **Accepted Insurances:** Blue Cross NC, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare
   * **Profile Page Tab:** [Tab 787784013] — `https://www.dukehealth.org/find-doctors-physicians/lori-stiegemeier-do`

3. **Dr. Ashley Wallace, MD** (Pediatrician)
   * **Clinic:** Duke Children's Primary Care Brier Creek
   * **Location:** 10211 Alm Street, Suite 200, Raleigh, NC 27617
   * **Accepted Insurances:** Blue Cross NC, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare
   * **Profile Page Tab:** [Tab 787784014] — `https://www.dukehealth.org/find-doctors-physicians/ashley-wallace-md`

4. **Dr. Brian H. Eichner, MD** (Pediatrician)
   * **Clinic:** Duke Children's Primary Care Brier Creek
   * **Location:** 10211 Alm Street, Suite 200, Raleigh, NC 27617
   * **Accepted Insurances:** Blue Cross NC, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare
   * **Profile Page Tab:** [Tab 787784015] — `https://www.dukehealth.org/find-doctors-physicians/brian-h-eichner-md`

5. **Dr. Martha A. Snyder, MD** (Pediatrician)
   * **Clinic:** Duke Children's Primary Care Brier Creek

   * **Accepted Insurances:** Blue Cross NC, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare

   * **Profile Page Tab:** [Tab 787784019] — `https://www.dukehealth.org/find-doctors-physicians/elizabeth-briere-md`

---

### Section 3: Daycare & Childcare Centers in Raleigh

1. **Children's Lighthouse of Raleigh**
   * **Location:** 13401 Leesville Church Road, Raleigh, NC 27617
   * **Age Range Served:** 6 weeks to 5 years (Infants, Toddlers, Preschool)
   * **Accreditation & Highlights:** Cognia Accredited; values-based curriculum; secure keypad entry; hours 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM.
   * **Tab:** [Tab 787784023] — `https://childrenslighthouse.com/leesville`

2. **The Goddard School of Raleigh (Creedmoor Road)**
   * **Location:** 6600 Creedmoor Road, Raleigh, NC 27613
   * **Age Range Served:** 6 weeks to 6 years (Infants through Pre-K)
   * **Accreditation & Highlights:** Cognia / AdvancED accredited; Wonder of Learning inquiry-based curriculum; STEAM enrichment; hours 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM.
   * **Tab:** [Tab 787784024] — `https://www.goddardschool.com/schools/nc/raleigh/raleigh-creedmoor-road`

3. **Primrose School of North Raleigh**
   * **Location:** 8521 Falls of the Neuse Road, Raleigh, NC 27615
   * **Age Range Served:** 6 weeks to 5–6 years (Infant through Kindergarten)
   * **Accreditation & Highlights:** Cognia accredited; proprietary Balanced Learning approach blending play and academics; hours 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM.
   * **Tab:** [Tab 787784025] — `https://www.primroseschools.com/schools/north-raleigh`

4. **Primary Beginnings Child Development Center**
   * **Location:** 2100 Spring Forest Road, Raleigh, NC 27615 (also centers at 4001 Falls of Neuse Rd and 4000 North Hills Dr)
   * **Age Range Served:** 6 weeks to 12 years (Infant, Toddler, Preschool, Before/After School)
   * **Accreditation & Highlights:** 5-Star rated by the NC Division of Child Development; established local community reputation.
   * **Tab:** [Tab 787784026] — `https://www.primarybeginnings.com/`

5. **Spanish for Fun! Duraleigh**
   * **Location:** 5600 Duraleigh Road, Raleigh, NC 27612
   * **Age Range Served:** 6 weeks to 24 months (Infant & Toddler Center; sister campuses serve up to age 5)
   * **Accreditation & Highlights:** 5-Star rated full Spanish language immersion daycare; hours 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM.
   * **Tab:** [Tab 787784027] — `https://spanishforfun.com/duraleigh-raleigh-nc-daycare/`

6. **Highwoods Park KinderCare**
   * **Location:** 3129 Poplarwood Court / 3200 Highwoods Blvd, Raleigh, NC 27604
   * **Age Range Served:** 6 weeks to 12 years (Infants to School-Age)
   * **Accreditation & Highlights:** Nationally accredited early childhood development program; full-day daycare with real-time app updates.
   * **Tab:** [Tab 787784028] — `https://www.kindercare.com/our-centers/raleigh/nc/301363`

7. **Copperfield Road KinderCare**
   * **Location:** 8301 Copperfield Road / 2300 Spring Forest Rd, Raleigh, NC 27615
   * **Age Range Served:** 6 weeks to 12 years (Infants, Toddlers, Discovery Preschool, Pre-K, School-Age)
   * **Accreditation & Highlights:** Full-day structured early learning curriculum; experienced long-tenured teachers.
   * **Tab:** [Tab 787784029] — `https://www.kindercare.com/our-centers/raleigh/nc/086123`

8. **Bright Horizons at Raleigh Corporate Center**
   * **Location:** 800 Corporate Center Drive, Suite 100, Raleigh, NC 27607
   * **Age Range Served:** 1 month to 5 years (Infants, Toddlers, Twos, Preschool, Kindergarten Prep)
   * **Accreditation & Highlights:** NAEYC Accredited (gold standard for early education); Discovery Driven Learning; hours 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM.
   * **Tab:** [Tab 787784030] — `https://www.brighthorizons.com/daycare-centers/nc/raleigh/800-corporate-center-drive-27607`

9. **Little by Little Preschool & Family Learning Hub**
   * **Location:** 322 S. East Street, Raleigh, NC 27601
   * **Age Range Served:** Approx. 18 months to 5 years (Toddlers and Preschoolers)
   * **Accreditation & Highlights:** Downtown Raleigh community-focused, play-based preschool with strong parent satisfaction and creative learning spaces.
   * **Tab:** [Tab 787784031] — `https://www.littlebylittleraleigh.com/`

10. **Chesterbrook Academy Preschool of Raleigh**
    * **Location:** 2215 Millbrook Road / 10200 Strickland Rd, Raleigh, NC 27615
    * **Age Range Served:** 6 weeks to 5 years (Infant to Pre-K)
    * **Accreditation & Highlights:** Cognia accredited; Links to Learning curriculum emphasizing early literacy, math, and social-emotional growth.
    * **Tab:** [Tab 787784032] — `https://www.chesterbrookacademy.com/preschools/nc/raleigh-durham/raleigh/`

---

### Comparative Judgment

* **Biggest Pediatrician Network in Raleigh:**
  **Blue Cross and Blue Shield of North Carolina (Blue Cross NC)** has the undisputed largest provider footprint in the Raleigh / Wake County area. In North Carolina, Blue Cross NC contracts with over 95% of licensed physicians, encompassing all primary clinical arms of Duke Health, WakeMed, and UNC Health, as well as premier independent practices like Raleigh Pediatric Associates and Oberlin Road Pediatrics. While UnitedHealthcare and Aetna both feature robust access to the major health systems, Blue Cross NC offers the fewest out-of-network surprises and widest pediatric choice across Wake County.

* **Most Highly Rated Daycare Centers:**
  **The Goddard School of Raleigh (Creedmoor Rd)** and **Primrose School of North Raleigh** consistently emerge as the most highly reviewed and trusted full-day early learning academies in the area, backed by dual Cognia/AdvancED accreditations and balanced academic-play curricula. For families seeking national clinical gold-standard credentials, **Bright Horizons at Raleigh Corporate Center** is especially notable as one of the few centers in the Triangle with NAEYC accreditation. Additionally, **Primary Beginnings** and **Spanish for Fun! Duraleigh** hold the State of North Carolina's highest possible 5-Star licensing rating.

### Comparative Judgment

* **Biggest Pediatrician Network in Raleigh:**

In North Carolina, Blue Cross NC contracts with over 95% of licensed physicians, encompassing all primary clinical arms of Duke Health, WakeMed, and UNC Health, as well as premier independent practices like Raleigh Pediatric Associates and Oberlin Road Pediatrics. While UnitedHealthcare and Aetna both feature robust access to the major health systems, Blue Cross NC offers the fewest out-of-network surprises and widest pediatric choice across Wake County.
